description: NHC 34-, 50- and 64-kt wind radii polygons for Hurricane Melissa (AL132025): the initial (analysed) wind field at each advisory and the forecast radii at each forecast hour to 72 h, all 80 advisories stacked (1,904 polygons). Quadrant extents NE/SE/SW/NW in nautical miles. This is the product to use for the wind field; the forecast cone is not. Derived columns advisory_number, advisory_seq, radii_kind, issue_time, synoptic_time, valid_time (UTC).

links.title: Forecast and initial wind radii (all 80 advisories)

table:columns.name: advisory_number
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): zero-padded advisory id, e.g. '003A'; join key across the forecast/* Collections.

table:columns.name: advisory_seq
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): 1-based issue order of the advisory (1..80).

table:columns.name: radii_kind
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): 'initial' = analysed wind field at advisory time (NHC initialradii file, 181 rows); 'forecast' = forecast radii at TAU 0..72 (NHC forecastradii file, 1,723 rows).

table:columns.name: RADII
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The wind speed in knots associated with the bounding polygon': 34 = tropical storm force (796 rows), 50 (684), 64 = hurricane force (424).

table:columns.name: STORMID
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'A unique character string ... BBNNYYYY' -> al132025.

table:columns.name: BASIN
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): basin code, lower-case 'al' in the radii files.

table:columns.name: STORMNUM
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): sequential number of the cyclone in the basin (13).

table:columns.name: ADVNUM
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): advisory number the radii belong to, same unpadded text as ADVISNUM ('20', '20A'); verified equal to the package's advisory.

table:columns.name: VALIDTIME
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The time in which a forecast or warning is in effect', YYYYMMDDHH UTC. Parsed into valid_time.

table:columns.name: SYNOPTIME
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'Initial time in the forecast cycle in which a tropical cyclones intensity and size are analyzed, occurring at 0000, 0600, 1200, or 1800 UTC' (YYYYMMDDHH). Parsed into synoptic_time.

table:columns.name: TIMEZONE
table:columns.description: NHC (undocumented field): time zone of VALIDTIME and SYNOPTIME; 'UTC' in the radii files.

table:columns.name: TAU
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): forecast hour from synoptic_time (0, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, 72); NHC forecasts radii only to 72 h.

table:columns.name: NE
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The largest distance of wind speed in Nautical Miles in the NE (0 - 90 degree) quadrant.'

table:columns.name: SE
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The largest distance of wind speed in Nautical Miles in the SE (90 - 180 degree) quadrant.'

table:columns.name: SW
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The largest distance of wind speed in Nautical Miles in the SW (180 - 270 degree) quadrant.'

table:columns.name: NW
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The largest distance of wind speed in Nautical Miles in the NW (270 - 360 degree) quadrant.'

table:columns.name: issue_time
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): issue time (UTC) of the advisory the package belongs to, copied from forecast/cone.

table:columns.name: synoptic_time
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): SYNOPTIME parsed to UTC; the 00/06/12/18 UTC cycle the TAU hours count from.

table:columns.name: valid_time
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): VALIDTIME parsed to UTC; 2025-10-21 12:00 to 2025-11-04 21:00 UTC.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Quadrant-wise wind-extent polygon built by NHC from the four radii (all valid) in lon/lat WGS 84 (typed OGC:CRS84 in the hosted file); coordinates as shipped by NHC, not transformed.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: GeoParquet bounding-box covering column (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) written for predicate pushdown; not an NHC attribute.
